title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract but still registered as a handler
description: MetricAlertDetectorHandler implements none of the four abstract members from StatefulDetectorHandler (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, build_occurrence_and_event_data), so it cannot be instantiated. It is still wired up as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler and called without an abstract-class guard, causing TypeError on first process_detectors call. Fix: either keep it on DetectorHandler with stub evaluate returning {} until real implementation lands, or provide stub implementations of the four abstract members. Also drop now-wrong TODO on grouptype.py:10.

title: `evaluate` docstring still describes the old list return
description: Function signature now returns dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but docstring still says 'returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult'. Actively misleads next implementer of stateful detector. Fix: update docstring to 'Evaluates a given data packet and returns a dict of DetectorEvaluationResult keyed by group key.'
